observations: All 5 TodoMVC hash-SPA variants show valid-only leakage 0.213-0.285 (42/168 raw leakage each; 37/130, 37/130, 23/108, 37/130, 37/130 valid).

Per-type stratification is perfectly separated on every SPA: link_click leakage_rate=1.00 (all 170 valid SPA link clicks), button_click=form_submit=js_navigate=0.00 (all 548 valid non-link transitions).

document.title is constant within each SPA variant across all 168 raw transitions (unique_titles=1, title_entropy 0.0 bits): vanillajs='TodoMVC: JavaScript Es6 Webpack', react='TodoMVC: React', vue='TodoMVC: Vue', angular='TodoMVC: Angular', svelte='TodoMVC: Svelte'.
Wikipedia valid-only leakage is 1.00 (100/100 genuine link clicks); 5 distinct titles across 5 sessions; 5 distinct normalized URLs.

Wikipedia session-0 hub (Main_Page) yielded 0/20 successful link clicks ('no article links' discovery failure); replacement session-0 hub (HTML article) yielded 20/20 successes. Superseded failures preserved in raw_wikipedia.json.
SPA error transitions (38/38/60/38/38 of 168) are failed toggle/destroy/filter actions (empty filter views, non-visible elements); excluding them raises leakage 0.25->0.21-0.28 and never above 0.40.
Normalized URL entropy is 0.0 bits on all SPAs (single path; fragments stripped per frozen normalization) vs 2.32 bits on Wikipedia (5 URLs).
Zero Playwright EPIPE crashes across 40 sessions (7 per SPA x5 + 5 wiki) using per-session browser lifecycle.
validity_notes: Spec URL shorthand (todomvc.com/examples/{vanillajs,react,vue,angular,svelte}/) mapped to live dist URLs (javascript-es6/dist, react/dist, vue/dist, angular/dist/browser, svelte/dist); same 5 framework variants, documented in collect_spa_survey.py and report.md.

Leakage rate is action-mix dependent by construction: link_click leaks at 1.00 everywhere, so reported 0.21-0.28 reflects the frozen 7-step protocol mix (27% link clicks), not an intrinsic site constant. Per-type table is the mix-free result.
Primary analysis uses valid-only transitions (error transitions excluded as unexecuted actions); all-raw sensitivity (0.25 all variants) reported alongside and never crosses 0.40.

Collection exceeded frozen minimums (7 sessions x24 =168 raw per SPA vs >=5 sessions/>=100 raw; wiki 5x20=100) to satisfy data-quality minimums with valid measurements; thresholds and decision rule unchanged.

Control naming: prereg section 4 swaps 'positive' (Wikipedia) vs 'null' (vanilla) labels relative to spec.json/decision_rule; packet follows spec.json keys and decision_rule expectations (wiki>80%, vanilla<60%).
POS_CTRL_VANILLAJS PARTIAL is driven solely by constant title (site property; title pipeline validated by 5 distinct Wikipedia titles on the same code path), not by pipeline failure.
TodoMVC demos are not production SPAs (no auth, single input, hash routing only); generalization to history-routed production SPAs untested.
No model calls, no authentication, single-day collection 2026-09-17; polite delays 300-1200ms between actions.
